BRCA1 is associated with familial cancer of breast, familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 1, pancreatic cancer susceptibility 4, and Fanconi anemia complementation group S.⁠1–4 I found 4 conditions related to BRCA1.⁠1–4

These diseases are linked to the gene named BRCA1.⁠5
